record.title: Star Wars Outlaws Gold Edition
record.description:
Experience the ultimate galactic adventure with Star Wars Outlaws on Nintendo Switch™ 2! Whether at home or on the go, enjoy an optimized handheld mode, immersive motion controls for key features, intuitive touch controls for menu navigation, and select minigames.

With the Star Wars Outlaws Gold Edition, get access to the base game and the Season Pass, including:
- Star Wars Outlaws: Wild Card story pack
- Star Wars Outlaws: A Pirate's Fortune story pack
- Jabba's Gambit exclusive mission
- The Kessel Runner character pack
- The Hunter's Legacy bundle
- The Cartel Ronin bundle

DISCOVER A GALAXY OF OPPORTUNITY
Explore distinct locations with bustling cities and cantinas. Race across sprawling outdoor landscapes on your speeder. Each location brings new adventures, unique challenges, and enticing rewards if you’re willing to take the risk.

EXPERIENCE AN ORIGINAL SCOUNDREL STORY
Live the high-stakes lifestyle of an outlaw. Turn any situation to your advantage with Nix by your side: fight with your blaster, overcome enemies with stealth and gadgets, or find the right moments to distract enemies and gain the upper hand.

EMBARK ON HIGH-STAKES MISSIONS
Take on high-risk, high-reward missions from the galaxy’s crime syndicates. Steal valuable goods, infiltrate secret locations, and outwit enemies as one of the galaxy’s most wanted. Every choice you make influences your ever-changing reputation.

JUMP INTO THE PILOT SEAT
Pilot your ship, the Trailblazer, as you engage in thrilling dogfights with the Empire and other foes. Find the right opportunities to chase, evade, and attack to get the upper hand.

If you’re willing to take the risk, the galaxy is full of opportunity.

Offer, content, and dates subject to change.

record.description_short: A two-part Mario package: the faster Switch version of Super Mario 3D World with four-player local/online co-op, plus Bowser's Fury, a free-roaming Lake Lapcat adventure where Mario and Bowser Jr. collect Cat Shines while surviving Fury Bowser.
record.description_ar: حزمة تضم Super Mario 3D World المحسنة على Switch مع تعاون محلي وأونلاين حتى أربعة لاعبين، إضافة إلى Bowser's Fury وهي مغامرة حرة في Lake Lapcat يتعاون فيها Mario وBowser Jr. لجمع Cat Shines ومواجهة Fury Bowser.

gameplayPillars.description: Run, jump, climb as Cat Mario and chase Green Stars, stamps and high scores across compact stages.

gameplayPillars.title: Four-player 3D World
gameplayPillars.description: Play the main campaign locally or online with Mario, Luigi, Peach and Toad.

gameplayPillars.title: Bowser's Fury freedom
gameplayPillars.description: Explore Lake Lapcat, collect Cat Shines and respond dynamically whenever Fury Bowser transforms the environment.

record.worldSummary: Super Mario 3D World spans the Sprixie Kingdom through compact obstacle-course stages. Bowser's Fury shifts to Lake Lapcat, an interconnected cat-themed environment whose islands change as Fury Bowser awakens.

storyChapters.title: Save the Sprixies
storyChapters.body: Bowser captures the Sprixie Princesses and Mario's group travels through a series of themed worlds.

storyChapters.title: World Bowser
storyChapters.body: The course-based adventure culminates in Bowser's neon amusement-park kingdom.

storyChapters.title: Lake Lapcat
storyChapters.body: Bowser's Fury sends Mario into a separate open environment where Bowser Jr. helps restore his father.

faq.q: Are 3D World and Bowser's Fury both included?
faq.a: Yes. Both are included in one Switch game.

faq.q: What changed on Switch 2?
faq.a: Nintendo's free update improves visuals and frame rate, adds Bowser's Fury HDR and enables GameShare.

faq.q: How many people can play?
faq.a: Super Mario 3D World supports up to four players; Bowser's Fury supports two-player local co-op.

record.verdictSummary: An exceptional double package: 3D World is one of Nintendo's best multiplayer platformers, while Bowser's Fury is a compact experiment in open-area Mario design.
verdictPros: Two excellent but distinct Mario experiences
Switch 2 update meaningfully improves Bowser's Fury
verdictCons: Bowser's Fury is shorter than a standalone Mario game
Original Switch handheld Bowser's Fury is 30 fps
Some 3D World stages become chaotic with four players

reviews.quote: Strong critic aggregate for the Switch package.
